comment: Independent wizard-mode punishment setup for display.c feel_location. This sighted recipe dismisses startup More, wishes for and reads a scroll of punishment, dismisses the reading and teleport prompts, then selects the current square. It verifies the punishment state and chained-ball status through the live teleport/getpos path; because the hero is sighted, this setup does not claim to exercise display.c feel_location. The blind tactile caller remains covered by feel-location-blind-variation.session.json.
